records.claim_text: The British Business Bank distinguishes cash timing from profitability and describes shortfalls when outgoings precede customer payment.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: No specific funding buffer, debt product, JGA forecast or current economic conclusion adopted.

records.claim_text: The Bank of England publishes daily spot reference rates and qualifies their authority; a published reference is not automatically a business transaction execution rate.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: No spot value retrieved or loaded. Foreign conversion direction, date, basis and actual fees must be explicit.

records.locator: Opening balance, receipts, outgoings and closing balance
records.claim_text: The Australian government guide rolls opening cash plus incoming less outgoing cash into closing cash and asks estimates to be labelled.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: General cash arithmetic only. Australian tax treatment, GST rate, business pattern or statement certification not imported.

records.locator: Researcher application to invoice, receipt and assumption state
records.claim_text: An expected receipt is a scenario input until cash occurs. A signed order, invoice, payment request or conditional acceptance balance does not establish a bank receipt date.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: No new current-contract payment term or actual bank reconciliation. Source/assumption and timing must be supplied for selected cash legs.

records.locator: Researcher application to deposit, credit and refund objects
records.claim_text: A credited deposit and remaining balance are cash legs against the same supplier object; a future-use credit is not a cash refund.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: Actual terms and payer/currency remain necessary. Economic expense, noncash entitlement and cash payment are not interchangeable.

records.claim_text: Monthly net cash can conceal earlier dated deficits. Date-end balances and a separately labelled same-day payments-first stress test are useful distinct views.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: The payments-first calculation is a constructed sequencing stress, not observed intraday settlement or a universal required reserve.

records.locator: Researcher application to route, window and currency
records.claim_text: Missing selected-scope dates, amounts or foreign FX basis should keep affected outputs unavailable; unselected event-only rows need not block a research-only case.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: No automatic FX=1 for foreign currency, missing amount=0, future date, event frequency or funding receipt is adopted.

records.locator: Researcher application to promised, satisfied and remaining units
records.claim_text: Payment and fulfilled benefit are different states. Remaining work, customer benefits, supplier payment and future-use credits require distinct typed units and timing.
records.review_mode: Selected official sections inspected; original/reader distinction retained; researcher application separately labelled.
records.interpretation_limits: Do not sum unlike units or treat positive projected cash as profit or discharge of unpaid/unfulfilled obligations. No remaining work cost is invented.
